population_total_basis: Population aged 10 and over enumerated in the 2002 census (the religion question, 'Religión que profesa', was asked only of persons 10+; national cuadro P16 universe 'Población de 10 años y más de edad'). Counts extracted from the CELADE INE REDATAM Webserver (base CPV2002) cross-tabulation of religion by department; the detailed denomination list is recoded to the published P16 seven-group frame. The denominator includes the non-response group 'No informado' (REDATAM 'No especificado').
